meta.tagline: The participatory map of a village in bloom.

footer.credits: A project by the community of Bugnara, in the Peligna Valley.

home.subtitle: House by house, alley by alley, an entire community has come together to bring colour back to its village. This is the map of that collective gesture.
home.intro_title: From an idea of two young people, it became everyone's.
home.intro_body_1: It started without fanfare: one winter morning, the idea of asking the people of Bugnara to embellish their homes, their corner of the alley, their patch of the square. With a flower, with a pot, with a thought.
home.intro_body_2: A few months later, the entire village had answered. Long-standing families, new residents, the elderly tending the square, the kids looking after a public garden. Each dot on this map is a story of care.
home.section_map_title: The map of the blooming village
home.section_map_body: Each dot is a house, a balcony, a small public space tended by a family or a group of volunteers. Click to discover photos, stories, and the names of those who contributed.
home.section_stories_body: The stories of those who got their hands in the soil. How the idea was born, why it grew, where it is going.
